section_summary: This section contains concluding pages of Natural Resources Section Report No. 50 on the iron and steel metallurgy of the Japanese Empire, presenting statistical tables on Korean pig iron and steel production along with NRS report and distribution lists. It also includes State Department correspondence, telegrams, and inquiries from 1948 and 1949 regarding iron ore procurement for Japan. These documents cover SCAP's international supply contracts as well as American commercial inquiries concerning iron ore exports and transpacific freight rates.

subfiles.about: Concluding pages of a report on iron and steel metallurgy, providing Korean production tables, a report list, and official distribution.
subfiles.from: Natural Resources Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers
subfiles.summary: This report provides statistical data on pig iron and steel production and blast furnaces in Korea from 1925 to 1945. It includes a cumulative catalog of published Natural Resources Section reports and an extensive distribution list covering Allied military and civilian occupation agencies.
subfiles.title: Report No. 50: Iron and Steel Metallurgy of the Japanese Empire
